faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.welcome: Hi! 👋 Pick a question below to learn more about Eco-Tracker.
faq.a1: Eco-Tracker is an app to track your daily carbon footprint and get tips to reduce it.
faq.a2: Yes, signing up and using Eco-Tracker is completely free.
faq.a3: Click 'Sign up' at the top, enter your name, email and password, and you're ready to go.
faq.a4: You can track car trips, meat consumption, electricity, flights and heating.
faq.a5: We use up-to-date scientific data to estimate emissions based on the type and amount of activity logged.
faq.a6: Yes, you can delete your account anytime from the Profile page.
